lines.japanese: 「うおおい、成田ァ！　てめ、これ運ンどけって言ったろがァ！」
lines.english: “Heeey, Narita! Told you to haul this shit outta here!”

lines.japanese: 「うっす！」
lines.english: “Yessir!”

lines.japanese: 「お？　おお……まあ、頼むわ」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh... Okay, I'm counting on you.”

lines.japanese: 「うらァ！　うらァ！」
lines.english: “HRAH! HRAH!”

lines.japanese: ぽーい、がしゃーん！　ぽーい、がしゃーん！
lines.english: Heave—crash! Heave—crash!

lines.japanese: 「っせんだよ、成田ァ！　声出さずにやれねえのかあ！」
lines.english: “Shut the hell up, Narita! Can't you work without screaming?”

lines.japanese: 「すんません！」
lines.english: “Sorry, sir!”

lines.japanese: ぽーい、がしゃーん！　ぽーい、がしゃーん！　ぽーい、がしゃがしゃーん！
lines.english: Heave—crash! Heave—crash! Heave—crash-crash!

lines.japanese: 「あ……ああ、いいよ。やっぱ声出せよ。なんかその勢いのまま無言でやられッと、そっちのが怖ェわ」
lines.english: “Ah... No. Forget it. Keep yelling. Watching you do all that in dead silence is scarier.”

lines.japanese: 「おーし、休憩にすっかあ！　メシにすんぞ、メシ」
lines.english: “All right! Break time! Food, boys—let's eat!”

lines.japanese: ヒゲの監督が大声を出すと、作業員たちはヘルメットや安全帯を外してのろのろと出口へ向かう。
lines.english: At the bearded foreman's bellow, the workers removed helmets and safety harnesses and trudged toward the exit.

lines.japanese: 「つかよぉ……最近の成田、アレなんなの？」
lines.english: “Seriously... What's gotten into Narita lately?”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、こんなやっつけ現場でムキんなられても、ウゼーだけっすよねー。アレじゃないすか、監督とか俺らに気に入られようとでも思って──」
lines.english: “Right? It's only some half-assed rush job. Him going all-out is just annoying. Maybe he thinks sucking up to the foreman and us will—”

lines.japanese: 「あの」
lines.english: “Excuse me.”

lines.japanese: 「──おわっ！　な、なんだよ、いきなり声かけんじゃねえよ成田！」
lines.english: “—Whoa! Wh-what, Narita? Don't sneak up on me like that!”

lines.japanese: 「自分、休憩終わったあとは、何から始めればいいっすか」
lines.english: “After break, what should I start with?”

lines.japanese: 「あー……だんだんガラ出しもなくなってきたしなあ……おまえさ、ハツリとかできんの？」
lines.english: “Uh... We're nearly done hauling debris. You know how to chip concrete?”

lines.japanese: 「すんません、道具使うのはまだちょっと」
lines.english: “Sorry. I’m not much good with the tools yet.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、しょーがねえな。メシ終わったら教えてやッからさ、あそこのでけえ柱あんべ？　あそこで待ってろ」
lines.english: “Well, can't be helped. I'll teach you after lunch. See that big column? Wait there.”

lines.japanese: 「うす」
lines.english: “Got it.”

lines.japanese: プリン頭の若い作業員は、初めて俺に指示を出すと、仲間のあとを走って追いかけていった。
lines.english: It was the first time the young worker with black roots under bleached hair had given me an instruction. Then he ran after the others.

lines.japanese: 鷲介と≪面談≫をした日から、俺は毎日現場へ顔を出していた。
lines.english: Every day since the *Interview* with Shusuke, I’d shown up at the site.

lines.japanese: 集合まで時間があるときは、ひとり家やベンチで体を休める。散歩や寄り道などせず、誰にも会うことなく、もちろん便利屋稼業などもすることなく、ただまっすぐ現場へ入る。
lines.english: When there was time before assembly, I rested alone at home or on a bench. No walks, no detours, no seeing anyone, certainly no odd jobs. Straight to the site.

lines.japanese: ここ最近はそんな感じだ。
lines.english: That was life lately.

lines.japanese: コンビニ袋を提げて詰所に入った。
lines.english: I entered the site office with a convenience-store bag dangling from one hand.

lines.japanese: 汚れたフライトテーブルの上にメットを放り、パイプ椅子にどかりと尻を載せる。ぎしり。鈍い音がした。
lines.english: I tossed my helmet onto the filthy folding table and dropped my ass into a folding chair. It answered with a dull creak.

lines.japanese: とりあえず弁当を買っては来たものの、まだ食べる気にはなれず、ただ天井に顔を向ける。
lines.english: I’d bought a boxed lunch. I still couldn’t make myself eat, so I just looked up at the ceiling.
“Haaah...”

lines.japanese: あれは鷲介との≪面談≫を終えた次の日だったか。
lines.english: Was it the day after my *Interview* with Shusuke?

lines.japanese: 状況を確認するため、俺は佐久間たちの掲示板を覗いてみた。
lines.english: I checked Sakuma's message board to see where things stood.

lines.japanese: 思ったより早い展開に、いくぶん拍子抜けした。無記名の投稿で「大司教、囚われる」。
lines.english: The news came sooner than I’d expected, leaving me strangely deflated. An anonymous post read: *Archbishop Captured.*

lines.japanese: やつを確保したのが治安を守る公権力か、子供たちの自警団か、あるいはべつの反社会的な組織なのかはまだ分からない。どうでもいい。正直どうでもいい。
lines.english: Whether he’d been taken by the authorities, the kids’ vigilante crew, or some other criminal outfit, I didn’t know. Didn’t care. Honestly didn’t care.

lines.japanese: 俺にとって大切なのは、あのイカれたオウム頭が街から消えたという事実──
lines.english: What mattered was that the deranged Parrot Head had disappeared from the city—

lines.japanese: ──つまり、小鳩を狙う脅威が取りのぞかれたということ。
lines.english: —meaning the threat to Kobato was gone.

lines.japanese: ──つまり、鳳翔との合議を開かねばならないということ。
lines.english: —meaning I had to sit down and talk things over with Kakeru Ohtori.

lines.japanese: 「めんどくせえな」
lines.english: “What a pain in the ass.”

lines.japanese: やつは俺に話があると言った。
lines.english: He had said he wanted to talk to me.

lines.japanese: なんの話だか知らないが、嫌な予感しかしない。
lines.english: I had no idea what he wanted to discuss, only a bad feeling about it.

lines.japanese: どうせ「俺たち」のことだろう。
lines.english: It would be about 'us.' What else?

lines.japanese: しかしどうでもいい。どうせ俺はじきに消えるんだ。
lines.english: But who cared? I'd be gone soon.

lines.japanese: 久しく均衡を保っていた「俺たち」の天秤は、おまえが現れた前後に傾きはじめた。
lines.english: The scales that had held 'us' in balance for so long began to tilt around the time you appeared.

lines.japanese: まったく、おまえといい鳳といい大司教といい、ろくなことをしねえ。
lines.english: Honestly. You, Ohtori, the Archbishop—nothing good from any of you.

lines.japanese: でも仕方ない。ずっと覚悟はしてきたんだ。だから俺は、不思議とそのことに対して諦観していた。ただ現場仕事にのみ精を出した。
lines.english: Still, it couldn't be helped. I'd prepared for this all along. Maybe that was why I felt strangely resigned to it. I poured everything into the work.

lines.japanese: いや、逆にそれらを打ちけしたくて、肉体労働に没頭していたのかもしれない。
lines.english: No. Maybe I buried myself in physical labor precisely to drown all of it out.

lines.japanese: とにかく何も考えたくなかった。そのために今の現場はうってつけだった。
lines.english: I wanted to think about nothing. This job site was perfect.

lines.japanese: 俺は余計なことを考えずにいるために、軽く眠りに入る。
lines.english: To keep stray thoughts away, I slipped into a light sleep.

lines.japanese: ああ、パルさんどうしてっかなあ……。
lines.english: Wonder how Paru's doing...

lines.japanese: メンマ、プラチナ、マルチネス、アリス……情けでエージを入れてやってもいいか……他にも面白い連中はいたけど、やつらは俺がいなくなっても、いつも通りの日々を送っているだろう。
lines.english: Menma, Platinum, Martinez, Alice... Maybe I'd be generous and throw Eiji in too. There were plenty of other funny people, but they'd all go on living the same as ever when I was gone.

lines.japanese: 俺はあいつらの日常の一コマに、ある時期たまたまフレームインしただけの通行人Ａだ。
lines.english: For a little while, I'd wandered into one frame of their everyday lives as Passerby A.

lines.japanese: 消えようがいなくなろうが、なにかが変わるわけじゃねえよ。それだけの話。
lines.english: Whether I disappeared or was just gone, nothing was gonna change. That's all.

lines.japanese: ただ……香田は、どうしてるだろうな……。
lines.english: But... I wondered how Koda was doing...

lines.japanese: いや、あいつだって今頃は真面目にガッコでも行って、飛びだせ青春みたいな日々を始めてるさ。
lines.english: No. By now she’d be going dutifully to school, starting one of those bright, wholesome high-school lives straight out of *Go Forth, Youth!*

lines.japanese: だってあいつは強ええし、愛嬌もあるし、誰からも嫌われたりしないはずだ。
lines.english: She was strong. Charming too. Nobody could hate her.

lines.japanese: 何か変わるわけじゃねえよ。それだけの話。
lines.english: Nothing would change. That was all.

lines.japanese: 俺は誰もいない詰所で、ぼうっと転寝しながら浅い夢を見ていた。
lines.english: Alone in the site office, I dozed and drifted into a shallow dream.

lines.japanese: 目が覚めると、思ったより時間は過ぎていた。
lines.english: When I woke, more time had passed than I'd thought.

lines.japanese: 俺は装備一式を身に付け、メットを掴んで現場へと向かった。
lines.english: I put on all my gear, grabbed my helmet, and returned to the site.

lines.japanese: 幸か不幸か、後半のキツさは半端じゃなかった。
lines.english: For better or worse, the second half was murderous.

lines.japanese: 俺はひたすら作業に打ちこんで、限界まで肉体を酷使した。
lines.english: I threw myself into the work and pushed my body to its limit.

lines.japanese: 日が明けるころには、足を前へ出すのが億劫なほど疲弊しきっていた。
lines.english: By daybreak I was so depleted that putting one foot before the other felt like too much trouble.

lines.japanese: おかげで俺は、考えたくもない不安や苦悩を考えずに済んだ。
lines.english: Thanks to that, I didn’t have to face the fears and anguish I wanted to avoid.

lines.japanese: ぼちぼち今日あたり消えるのかな、とか、そんなん。
lines.english: Like maybe today was finally the day I'd disappear. Stuff like that.

lines.japanese: ま、もういいだろ、この辺で。
lines.english: Well. That’s enough of that.

lines.japanese: なあ。おまえ、いつまで俺の話を聞いてンだよ。
lines.english: Hey. How long are you going to keep listening to me?

lines.japanese: もう俺はいいよ。旅の支度はできた。早く迎えにこいって。
lines.english: I’ve had enough. I’m ready for the journey. Hurry up and come get me.

lines.japanese: 来る日も来る日も東から昇っては憂鬱を巻きちらしている炎の玉っころが、飽きもせず今日もまた顔を覗かせてきた。
lines.english: Day after day, that ball of fire rose in the east and spread gloom wherever it went. Today, as though it never tired of the routine, it showed its face again.

lines.japanese: 俺は手をかざしてそいつを睨みながら、住宅街の坂道を息せき切って上っていった。
lines.english: I held up a hand and glared at it, climbing the neighborhood hill short of breath.

lines.japanese: で、おまえ誰？
lines.english: “So... who are you, anyway?”
